Dear Mehek, 💌

Happy Birthday, Mehek! 🌷
I hope this year gives you a thousand reasons to smile, people who understand your silence, and moments that make your heart feel light. Tumhari life mein khushiyan itni aayein ki sad hone ka time hi na mile… although tum drama karne ka time phir bhi nikaal hi logi. 😂💗

And honestly, I hope you never forget how special your presence can be. This little page is just a reminder that someone took time to make something just for you. Keep shining, keep being your wonderfully unpredictable self, and please birthday ke din thoda kam attitude dikhana… bas aaj ke liye. 😏🎂
